result.summary: The landlord (Felix) replied that the oven should go back under warranty, at no charge, to the contractor Keystone Works used to replace it last year. Nothing in the records says who that contractor is, so I can't assign anyone yet. I emailed the landlord asking for the contractor's details and the warranty paperwork, told the tenant what happens next, and put the ticket on hold with a 2-day follow-up. I did not mark the pending approval as resolved: the landlord asked for a free warranty repair and did not approve any cost.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 006: the landlord tells us how he wants the repair handled (warranty, charge-free, through the previous installer). He gives no open approval and no budget. The classifier said 'review' (conditional_approval 0.33, unconditional 0.05, needs_human_response 0.79). Event 005 asked whether a reply to the landlord was needed, and one is: we can't name or contact the installer without his details. The landlord can answer this, so I asked him rather than escalating.
